phoneme_focus: 'had' /həd/ → 'd contraction; past participle endings in narration

grammar_point.title: Past perfect (simple & continuous)
grammar_point.en: Show an earlier past before another past action; had done vs had been doing.
grammar_point.ar: التعبير عن ماضٍ أسبق من ماضٍ آخر؛ had done مقابل had been doing.

vocabulary.example: The train had already left.
By the time we arrived, it had ended.
She had called earlier.
We had met previously.
I had eaten before I left.
After he had finished, he rested.
The film had just started.
I had never seen anything like it.
I realised I had left my bag.
I had forgotten his name.
We had prepared everything.
By then the guests had arrived.
They had left before dawn.
It was harder than I had expected.
We had planned to travel.
She had already decided.
A lot had happened before then.
The situation had changed.
The reason had become clear.
I had gained useful experience.
I explained the background.
Once I knew the context, it made sense.
The sequence of events was clear.
It had serious consequences.
I was exhausted because I hadn't slept.
I felt relieved once it had ended.
I was confused because I had missed the start.
They had been waiting for hours.
I had been studying all day.
Up to that point, everything had gone well.
It was a real turning point.
In the end, it had all worked out.

Saturday.prompt: Say three things that had happened before an event: 'By the time..., I had...'

Sunday.prompt: Tell a short story making clear which action happened first (past perfect).

Monday.prompt: Explain why you felt a certain way using 'because I had (been)...'

Tuesday.prompt: Use past perfect continuous: 'I had been ...-ing for...' before something happened.

Wednesday.prompt: Describe a turning point and what had led up to it.

Thursday.prompt: Ask a partner about a time they arrived somewhere and something had already happened.

Friday.prompt: Tell a layered story (9-10 sentences) mixing past simple/continuous/perfect.

writing_prompts: Write four sentences with 'By the time..., ... had ...'.
Write a short story making the order of events clear (past perfect).
Explain three feelings using 'because I had (been)...'.
Write three past perfect continuous sentences.
Describe a turning point and what had led up to it.
Rewrite three events in the correct time order using past perfect.
Write a paragraph narrating a memorable day with layered past tenses.
